overview.oneLineTake: Mild overnight bid and a yield pullback set a fragile calm; tonight's jobs print still decides whether October gets relief or another vol spike.
themes: NFP day: September payrolls at 7:30 PM BKK (f ~84–89K / UE 4.1% / AHE 0.3%) with October Fed hold odds near ~70%+.
Thursday's yield snapback: 10y hit ~5.34% (highest since 2002) then closed ~5.24%; stocks scraped higher (S&P ~+0.2%, Dow/Nasdaq flat).
Overnight futures lightly bid into the print (ES ~+0.1%, NQ ~+0.3%) while DXY holds ~102 and gold ~4,210.
Oil/geopolitics back on: Brent +4% to ~$102 on a third U.S. carrier to the Middle East; WTI ~$93.
Side tape: hot Tokyo Core CPI 2.7%, EZ CPI flash 4 PM BKK; Nike slid after a sales miss and restructuring.
risks: Hot payrolls/wages reprice hike odds and restart the long-end selloff.
Soft NFP could flip USD/yields but also raise growth/recession concerns into weekend positioning.
Oil spike keeps an inflation tail risk live even if jobs cool.
Weekly index losses still on the table if the print disappoints breadth.

nq.summary: NDX scraped higher as 10Y retreated from a 2002-era 5.34% spike to ~5.24% after Jefferson echoed "more time" on hikes; overnight NQ stays lightly bid on semis, but the whole book is binary into tonight's jobs print (f ~89–90K / UE 4.1% / AHE 0.3%). Trade the calm — don't press it.
nq.overnight: Asia quiet; US fut modest green (NQ ~+0.3%, ES softer). Brent ~+$4 overnight on Middle East carrier headlines — inflation tail still live.
nq.macro: Oct-hike odds cooled further (~70%+ hold) as front-end yields led the bull steepener; sticky long end + firm DXY still tax multiples until NFP clears.
nq.volatility: VIX 16.4 · VXN 22.5 — Nasdaq vol still richer into the print; treat as event vol, not trend vol.
